Title: Vinod's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vinod - 30 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Meenakshi - 58 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Vinod stands in the ward. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Vinod: "Today feels like a good day."

[Vinod checks Mother's pulse.]

Vinod (excited): "This is amazing!"

[Vinod lies down on the hospital bed.]

Vinod: "Okay."

[Vinod sits in a wheelchair.]

Vinod: "How beautiful!"

[Vinod walks to the reception desk and asks for the doctor.]

Vinod: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Vinod coughs and holds his chest.]

Vinod (gently): "That was such a fun day!"
